name: Bakunyuu Gyaru Chikan Densha
source:
A man with nothing to lose has no fear.
The protagonist is working a dead-end, stressful job, and has no prospects or interests in life.
Except one thing, his one and only joy in life...molesting girls on the train.
However, one morning, a busty gal catches him, and the gig is up.
Now, he has lost even his job, and he has nothing left.
All that remains...is to exact his molesting revenge upon her!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ371462.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
一無所有的人，無所畏懼。
主角做著一份毫無前途、壓力沉重的工作，生活中沒有盼頭，也沒有興趣。
只有一件事，是他唯一的樂趣……在電車上猥褻女性。
然而某天早上，他被一名胸部豐滿的辣妹逮個正著，一切就此敗露。
如今，連工作也丟了，他再沒有任何東西可失去。
剩下的……只有向她展開痴漢式的報復！
